items.reason: Both coders agree the MTAP row is an eligibility match; the only difference is whether TNG462 is also named. The primary outcome (candidate_matched_selection true) is the same either way.
The record has nine EXPERIMENTAL arms (e.g. 'Phase 1 Arm 1 - S095035 single-agent dose escalation'), none acting as a control; not_applicable is only for single-arm trials.
PK is planned ('AUC from 0 to infinity', 'Cmax', 'Ctrough') but no sample type is stated; the manual codes this unclear rather than assuming plasma.

note: S095035 role differs by arm (single agent in Arms 1/1a-1d, experimental_combination with TNG462 in Arms 2/2a-2c). IDH-wildtype applies only to define the CNS subgroup ('IDHwt glioblastoma') and is not a selection biomarker; CDKN2A is only a China pre-screening trigger. D31-A1 does not apply: MTAP homozygous deletion is required of all participants, including IDHwt glioblastoma. Record states S095035 is 'an oral methionine adenosyltransferase 2A [MAT2A] inhibitor' and TNG462 'a protein arginine N-methyltransferase 5 [PRMT5] inhibitor' in an MTAP-deleted population (keyword 'Synthetic Lethality'), so the match is not an open A6 question. D31-C3: GBM patients can enter both single-agent (Phase 1 Arm 1, Arm 1d basket) and combination (Phase 1 Arm 2) arms; regimen kept combination. Harmonisation checked: no change. MTAP deletion is linked to S095035 (MAT2A) and TNG462 (PRMT5) as stated in the record and by established pharmacology (D31-A6).
